messages:
sarah: Quick sync  small release window in 30m (00:10-00:30 UTC) to reconcile a cross-service pin discrepancy. Services: API, runtime, router, console. Goal: staged pin to restore compatibility and avoid full rollback.

sarah: Problem summary: runtime variant annotation drift caused router to route a few orgs to an incompatible runtime build. Need coordinated repin + routing reconciliation.

mike: I saw the drift in the deploy-log: variant metadata `build_meta.schema=opt-in` didn9t propagate. I can cut a `v3.9.1-repin` with explicit schema flag.

jordan: Console needs a transient client-side guard: `console.guard_schema_v2=true` so UI stops sending new optional fields to affected orgs. I can toggle via feature gate for the org list.

lee: Router will apply regional steering for affected orgs only, not a blunt percent. Command: `router steer --orgs=@affected --to fallback-pool --reason \"variant-drift\"`. Fallback pool will be pinned to runtime `v3.8-stable`.

deploy-bot: preflight ok: CI green, infra quotas ok, smoke tests pass. Linked: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/140 (re-pin), https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/5021 (compat shim).

release-coordinator: ops note: quiet window 00:00-00:40 UTC. Oncall: lee (primary), mike (secondary).

sarah: Rollout plan (short): 1) toggle console.guard_schema_v2 for affected orgs 2) router steer affected orgs -> fallback-pool 3) apply runtime repin `v3.9.1-repin` to fallback pool 4) apply API compat shim to canary 5) verify traces and metrics 6) remove steering and flag after 20m if green.

mike: Rollback triggers: error rate increase >0.5% for affected orgs OR latency spike >150ms OR new 5xx pattern. Rollback actions: a) route back to default pool b) revert runtime repin tag c) disable console.guard_schema_v2 d) revert API shim.

jordan: I9ll prepare support blurb: \"Short window to repair runtime routing; minor UI guard temporarily enabled for specific orgs.\"

lee: Acks: I9ll own routing commands and immediate rollback if any 503 pattern.

mike: I9ll push repin and watch runtime tails.

sarah: Kicking at 00:10 UTC. React :thumbsup: if you9re set.

lee: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: orchestration start 00:10 UTC. Applied console.guard_schema_v2 for affected orgs.

lee: router steer applied -> affected orgs -> fallback-pool.

mike: runtime repin `v3.9.1-repin` applied to fallback-pool. API shim deployed to canary for affected orgs.

sarah: Monitoring link: https://grafana.redwood/d/serve/pin-reconcile-3500. Watch traces for missing field errors.

mike: First 10m: latency stable, errors for affected orgs dropped 92%. Good signal.

jordan: Console guard reduced new-field sends by 95% for those orgs.

lee: Holding 20m, then we'll lift steering.

deploy-bot: hold complete, removing routing steer and console guard.

mike: Post-lift: runtime metrics normal, no regressions.

jordan: Console guard removed, UI back to normal for all orgs.

sarah: Closing window. Notes: \"fast repin and regional steering to resolve variant metadata drift; no rollback required.\" I9ll file the short postmortem and tag associated PRs.

release-coordinator: orchestration finished successfully. Quiet window end 00:40 UTC.

sarah: Thanks team. If anything regresses reopen thread and follow rollback checklist above.
